text:
Carmen: Quick bug from mobile QA on a foldable (width snaps between 360/720): when the rail collapses the runs table briefly loses bottom padding and the last row is partially hidden. GIF: https://redwood-internal.screens/fold-snap.gif

Noah: Is that only on foldables or also on regular phones?

Carmen: Seen on both, but foldables make it worse because the viewport width changes mid-session. The issue looks like 100vh + header recompute.

Ivy: We should avoid 100vh for the list container. Use min-height and update via visualViewport.height on resize. Also add padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) so the bottom nav doesn't cover rows.

Ravi: Agree. Another thing: when the rail overlays, the row action menu ends up behind it. We need to portal popovers to a root layer. Portaled popovers should use position:fixed and compute coords from getBoundingClientRect.

Noah: For breakpoints, product asks for icon-only at medium narrowness and overlay for tiny phones. Can we standardize: >=520 full, 440-519 icons-only, <=439 overlay? That seems to work across our device set.

Ivy: Sounds good. Design note: icon-only must keep 44px touch targets. We should expand hit areas with transparent padding rather than shrinking controls.

Carmen: UX tweak: change the toggle label to say "Open navigation" / "Close navigation" for screen readers. And disable hover tooltips on touch devices; they block taps.

Ravi: Implementation plan: 1) portal popovers to root (fixed), 2) avoid transforms on popover ancestors, 3) listen to visualViewport resize instead of 100vh, 4) CSS vars for breakpoints to allow quick tweaks. I'll add auto-close of any open row menus when the rail toggles to avoid two overlays.

Noah: Can design add a sandbox variant that toggles between 360/720 fold states so we can replay the snap? Also keyboard-only test for focus trap when overlay active.

bench-bot: Added sandbox variants (360, 412, 720 folded), linked visual diffs and accessibility checklist. Tags: mobile-responsive, foldable, a11y.
